About SIP Abacus

SIP Abacus Yelahanka New Town

At SIP Abacus Yelahanka New Town, we are committed to helping children unlock their true potential through fun, structured, and scientifically designed brain development programs.

Using the globally trusted SIP Abacus curriculum, children progress from physical abacus calculations to powerful mental arithmetic, building exceptional speed, accuracy, and confidence. Conducted in small batches by certified trainers, our classes provide personalised attention and regular assessments to ensure steady progress.

Beyond mathematics, our program nurtures concentration, memory, logical thinking, creativity, and self-confidence — equipping children with essential skills for lifelong academic success.

Empowering Young Minds. Building Confident Futures.

Why Choose SIP?

What sets our program apart

Four things parents tell us they value most when they compare us to other abacus programs.

01

Certified trainers

Every instructor completes SIP's internal certification and yearly refresher training before leading a batch.

02

Small batch sizes

Capped at 8 students per batch so every child gets individual correction and pacing.

03

11-level curriculum

A clear progression from physical bead counting to full mental visualisation, across 11 levels with a test at every stage.

04

Flexible formats

Choose in-centre or online batches, with weekday and weekend timings to fit school schedules.

Programs

A track for every age

Three progressive tracks, each broken into levels so children move at a pace that suits them.

Junior

Junior Track

Ages 5 – 7

A unique blend of Abacus learning and personality development, designed using a fun "Play & Learn" approach that keeps young children engaged while building essential life skills.

Levels 1–42hr 15min / week
Book Junior demo
Foundation

Foundation Level

Ages 8 – 10

Marks the pivotal transition from physical abacus to mental calculation, laying the groundwork for true mental math mastery. Children begin visualising the abacus in their minds, enabling faster, more accurate calculations with confidence. Covers multiplication, mental & number visualisation, speed & accuracy, concentration enhancement, and confidence building.

Levels 3–52hr 15min / week
Book Foundation demo
Advanced

Advanced Track

Ages 11 – 14

Takes mental math to the next stage, where children confidently solve complex calculations without a physical abacus — enhancing logical thinking, visualisation, concentration, and calculation speed, and preparing them for real-world problem-solving.

Levels 6–112hr 15min / week
Book Advanced demo

Benefits

Five ways abacus training helps your child

Concentration

Sustained focus on rapid bead sequences trains longer attention spans.

Memory

Visualising the abacus builds a strong photographic working memory.

Confidence

Solving problems faster than classmates builds real self-belief in math.

Faster Calculations

Mental math replaces slow, written methods with instant recall.

Creativity

Whole-brain engagement supports imaginative, flexible thinking beyond math.
